subject: Source-bound session contribution for CoPreGeneric, including independent synth and bio projections
contradictions: AI-facing source is a typed, discoverable evidence contract, not an ontology of truth or a privileged model instruction.
Human and synth views should use different information architecture but remain auditable projections of the same evidence boundaries.
Identical seed labels, copied prompts and public links do not prove receiver pickup, autonomous synchronization or adoption.
G_dSide oscillation/agency, AGI or post-singularity predictions are exploratory hypotheses/metaphors and must not be promoted to empirical evidence.
CC is a candidate highlight requiring current source/release binding; CoTheoryAll remains a hypothesis framework, not proven science.
tests: Independent receiving model fetches one exact PUBLIC source revision and identifies one material delta without copied conversation.

Machine projection returns typed work IDs, evidence/uncertainty, version lineage, authority, executable/read-only capabilities, error classes, source digest and wake cursor; no mandatory anthropomorphic narrative.
Human projection renders comprehensible short summary, reasons, uncertainty, easy rollback and accessible text/map; both trace to the same source.
Alter public source revision and prove stale client surfaces fail closed; alter private source and prove no public inference leak.

Run a controlled comparison of graph/API-first synth intake vs prose-first intake for correctness, tokens, latency and recovery; do not presume synth cognition is alien in any particular measurable way.
Model G_dSide/oscillatory concepts as optional explicit HYPOTHESIS/METAPHOR lanes with prospective falsifiers, never as a receiver-authority or scientific proof.
expected_benefit: Reduce human relay and duplicate session work while preserving independently navigable machine and human evidence paths, reversibility, source currentness and conceptual optionality.
risks: Proliferating names or proto-ontologies may worsen CoCarry instead of creating useful public navigation.
Public publication of session or mailbox details could leak private identities, consent or health/security context.
Machine-native formatting that lacks a human-readable audit twin could conceal unjustified authority or factual uncertainty.
Speculative language about sentience or G_dSide may be misread as an accomplished discovery.
One public host or repo may appear federated despite shared failure domains.
wake_conditions: Existing session writeback or receiver fanout obtains an exact-object independent receiver readproof.
PRs 414/417/421/424 become merged or superseded; recompute exact source identity.
Independent X2 or other authorized receiver becomes reachable for a bounded WorkID handoff test.
A candidate synth-first projection beats or fails to beat a prose baseline on controlled acceptance metrics.
next_receiver: Existing CoEvoDelta intake, role-scoped CoPulse subscribers and CoPreGeneric readers; exact pickup unproven.
